notes: All 7 web searches ran this time (the six required plus one on Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors); none returned any statement by Roger Williams on AI risk, superintelligence, extinction, a pause or slowdown, a China agreement or AI safety. The site-restricted search did not stay on williams.house.gov and returned no AI material from his site. No House letter on AI risk led or signed by him was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, as instructed). From the earlier attempt: the official press release listing pages (page=0 to page=3, about April 2025 to 11 November 2026) showed no 2026 release mentioning AI; releases between 12 March and 28 April 2026 did not appear in those pages. The 14 September 2026 Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act release names China but not AI. The D quote was re-read at source this time (29 April 2025 release); the source has a trailing comma after 'victims', left off the quote. Hearing remarks and floor speeches were not checked beyond these searches.
